item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day's got structure around it — check-ins with yourself, a moment to ask if what you're doing actually fits the life you want, and space to catch when you're assuming instead of knowing. That's the real work today, not just getting through the list. Action: before you react to something today, pause and ask if you're mind-reading or dealing with facts.
